final: WITH invoice_values AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, SUM(derived_total_cost) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(product_price), 0) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM invoice_values) SELECT AVG(i.avg_line_product_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(i.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(i.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM invoice_values AS i CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE i.ratio > o.avg_ratio
